name: Solstice
tagline: Intraday option buying on NSE stocks
summary: Solstice buys one stock option on each signal across 46 NSE stocks: a call when Firefly's rules turn up, a put when they turn down. Positions are opened during the session and almost always closed the same day, on a trend reversal, a target, a stop or the end of the day.
risk: Option buyers can lose the whole premium paid on a trade. These results are before brokerage, taxes and slippage; stock options trade with wider spreads than index options, so real fills would be worse than the prices used here. At its busiest this backtest had 44 positions and about ₹9.2 lakh of premium open at once, more than the ₹2 lakh starting capital; the percentage figures are measured on the starting capital.
